findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: The ice machine is observed to have an excessive amount of mold build-up. PIC has been contacted and will be performing a cleaning and sanitizing of the ice machine. A follow-up is being issued for 7-3-2023 to observe the ice machine in compliance. Ensure the ice machine is cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean and free of mold/build-up.
4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the cabinet holding the bag in box soda to have areas of raw wood such as the side panel, the edges to the doors and the top header 2X4. Paint or seal all raw wood so that it is smooth, non absorbent and easily cleanable.  d
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
No test strips were available at the time of the inspection. Provide test strips to accurately test the concentration of sanitizer.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
Sanitizer in the three compartment sink tested at 0-100 ppm quaternary ammonium. Provide sanitizer according to the label, which calls for 200-400 ppm quaternary ammonium. Sanitizer was added to sink to provide the proper concentration. Having test strips available will help employees prepare this correctly.
750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
No proof of a certified food manager. As a medium risk facility under the FDA Food Code, the person in charge at the time of the inspection will be required to have a certified food manager certificate (8 hour course). Illinois required one full time employee with this certification, but this will be changing in January. Provide enough certified food managers so that the person in charge is certified. All other employees will need Food Handler Training.
750-540 All Category II facilities must have at least one full-time Licensed Food Service Sanitation Manager employed at the facility to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide at least one fulltime Food Service Sanitation Manager.
